Hi all,

Finance review complete — notes below: 

- Weekly invoicing: feasible. Operational impact: increases invoice count by ~4x during pilot; we'll want to ensure credit memos/adjustments are handled in the same stream.
- Billing implementation: we will create a separate billing schedule under the same account that emits weekly invoices. That creates distinct invoice numbers but can be aggregated in your ledger via our "billing reference" field.
- PO & cost-center: we can include PO number and a free-text "customer reference" field where CC-5632 can be placed. If you require the cost center in an XML/EDI field, that will take ~2 weeks for the integration.
- Net terms: accepting Net 45 is OK for the pilot, but for production we need Net 30 or an approved credit hold policy documented. For Net 45 we will require a signed SOW that references extended terms to be safe for revenue recognition.

Action items from finance:
- Lily: confirm whether the cost-center needs to be machine-parsable (EDI/XML) or free-text on PDF.
- Logan: if Solstice wants weekly invoices permanently, budget for a small monthly billing ops fee to cover increased reconciliation (we can waive for a 90-day pilot).
